one_line: The paper proposes an energy-management-system formation method using QFD/Voice-of-Customer and House-of-Quality tools, demonstrated on strategic-goal alignment data from the petrochemical producer JSC KazanOrgSyntez; the focus is management methodology rather than the continuous production process itself.
